name: @edgegamers/jailbreak-guards
description: Guard queue, prisoner:guard ratio, playtime priority and CT bans (port of EdgeGamers CTBans).

min_priority_for_ct.description: Priority (minutes alive) needed to guard; eG+ are exempt (MinimumPriorityForCT).

priority_caps.description: group=cap pairs; a player's cap is the highest of their groups' caps, else default (MaximumPriority).

allow_dangerous_ctbans.description: Let manager/srmanager/commgr issue uncapped and permanent CT bans (AllowDangerousCTBans).

restart_delay_seconds.description: mp_restartgame delay when the first guard queues into an empty CT.

priority_tick_seconds.description: Seconds per +1 priority for alive players.

priority_min_players.description: Real players needed for priority to accrue (unless a chat admin is online).

ctban_max_minutes.description: Longest CT ban below manager rank.

ctban_max_minutes_manager.description: Longest CT ban for manager/srmanager/commgr (unless allow_dangerous_ctbans).

ctban_immediate_move_minutes.description: Bans longer than this move the target to T immediately.

penalty_min_bans.description: Bans within the window that trigger the priority penalty.

prune_after_days.description: Delete non-permanent bans that ended this long ago (on map start).
